name: camera
title: player.camera
lead: What they look out of: a camera from camera.fixed/free/orbit/chase, or nil or false for their own eyes. No delay is needed after creating its target. Ends when the target is destroyed or the player leaves the room.

usedIn.quote: player.camera = cam            -- look out of a camera (see cameras); nil or false is their own eyes
player.camera = nil                                       -- their own eyes again
| A different viewpoint | `player.camera` | Controls the view; `chase` composes with riding. |
